count_definition: Unique selected test identities per SDK, with initially skipped bound-CPU cases counted once after successful replay. The initial full-run skip records are retained. SDK runs are separate executions; identical generated source inputs are not independent semantic cases.

development_witness.first_build_failure: New test EXPECT_EQ macro needed parentheses around a braced ternary operand; corrected before execution.
development_witness.red_failure: One test, two load/store controls: changing CR4.OSXSAVE during backing suspension incorrectly completed an unfinished instruction.
development_witness.repair: Retain the complete paging-control snapshot and reject a changed binding before resume.
development_witness.initial_r6_build: Diagnostic build only; superseded by the clean-source final build after the controls snapshot change.
development_witness.full_source_invocation_repair: Initial full source invocations omitted NEVERD_TEST_NEVERC_LLC, failing the two NeverC i386 SDK/CLI export cases. The complete 165-test source matrix was rerun with the full LLVM backend explicitly bound; the first run, logs and verified binary archive are retained separately. No product-code change was needed.

limitations: MPX semantics are qualified for the explicit one-CPU WholeOperandRAM software profile, not physical MPX hardware.
MPX instruction dispatch is code32; code16 MPX, 16-bit addressing and non-flat-DS bounds tables remain unqualified.
Whole BNDMOV/BTE publication and eight-byte BNDMOV alignment are bound profile choices, not a claim about every hardware partial-access order.
Transactions/abort continuation, MMIO, shared-memory synchronization and ordinary function-ABI MPX state transport remain outside this interface.
Full mode/task transitions, remaining original-machine banks/providers, software SMM/SGX and unbound asynchronous event producers remain global gaps.
